context: Use the Parquet tables under data/. See context/description.md for file paths, field descriptions. Hints are optional and selected by the experiment configuration.
query: As of 2023-01-01, list all projects whose most recent report (dated on or before 2023-01-01) records both a type of 'capital' and a status of 'design' and that have accumulated total funding of more than $500,000. Accumulated total funding means the sum of all funding amounts granted to that project on or before 2023-01-01.
